zh-CN.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 实测：速度、价格与代码边界
zh-CN.summary: 36 次官方 API 实测：默认与关闭思考的短文本各 15/15，正文首响中位数 1.113 秒与 0.661 秒；公开两次代码失败、完整参数和原始回答。

sections.title: 先看结论：短题可靠，代码边界仍需检查
sections.body:
TOKRACE 于 2026 年 10 月 18 日直接调用 DeepSeek 官方 API，对同一组 15 道中文短文本题分别开启默认思考、关闭思考，再测试 3 道 JavaScript 函数题，共 **36 次请求**。没有重试或丢弃失败记录。

两组短文本均为 **15/15**；默认思考正文首响中位数 **1.113 秒**，关闭思考 **0.661 秒**。代码任务两组均为 **2/3**：金额解析题分别出现预算耗尽与前导零处理错误。短题通过率不能代表复杂推理、完整项目开发或 Agent 能力。

实际使用建议：固定格式抽取可先尝试关闭思考；代码必须用业务边界测试验收，并为思考预算不足设置明确的失败处理。这是基于本次小样本的分析，不是普遍排名。

sections.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 是什么？
sections.body:
这是 2026 年 10 月 17 日的 V4.1 Flash 更新。官方 API 继续使用 `deepseek-flash`；本次响应也只返回该别名。1017 的版本归属依据[官方更新日志](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates/)，不能通过这个可变别名永久锁定同一检查点。

官方规格列出 1M 上下文、384K 最大输出、图片输入与工具调用；权重仓库采用 MIT 许可。这里的规格属于来源信息，本次只验证短文本与函数输出。[官方规格](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/) · [官方模型卡](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017)

不要把本站 9 月的临时预览 ID `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` 当作这次正式接口。旧预览页保留历史说明，当前入口见[模型页](/zh-CN/model/deepseek-flash)。

sections.title: 官方公布了哪些变化？
sections.body:
下面是厂商模型卡公布的成绩，不是 TOKRACE 复现结果。

| 基准 | 9 月版本 | 1017 版本 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Terminal-Bench 4.0 | 31.2 | 42.3 |
| DeepSWE v1.1 | 74.2 | 77.0 |
| ProgramBench | 20.3 | 29.1 |

官方还表示任务耗时与输出长度下降。Terminal-Bench 使用 Claude Code，DeepSWE 使用 Mini-SWE-V2；框架和题目影响结果。本站没有可固定调用的 9 月基线，因此不能从本次测试得出“比旧版快多少”。[数据来源与评测注释](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017)

sections.title: 测试怎么跑：参数、路径与计时口径
sections.body:
文本题采用 `tasks-2026-09-26.1` 固定任务：JSON 信息抽取、严格格式约束、基于材料的问答，各 5 题。每题每模式仅调用一次，两模式先后顺序按题交替；题目、期望值和检查规则在调用前确定。代码题检查金额解析、特殊键去重、区间合并。

从本地 macOS 客户端直连 `https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions`，串行流式请求，单次超时 120 秒。网络出口与服务区域未确认；这些结果不混入香港节点标准报告或社区测速排行榜。

提交 `temperature=0`、文本 `max_tokens=2048`、代码 `max_tokens=4096`；默认组省略思考参数，另一组提交 `thinking: {type: "disabled"}`。官方默认开启思考、effort 为 high，且思考模式忽略 temperature，所以不能把默认组称为确定性采样。[参数说明](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode/)

正文首响从发起请求计时到第一段非空正文，**不把思考内容计作正文**；总耗时到流结束。短输出容易受网络和缓冲影响，因此不从总 completion token 推算正文 tok/s。缓存未预热或清空，服务负载未控制。

sections.title: 实测结果：通过率、首响与 token
sections.body:
| 短文本指标（每组 15 次） | 默认思考 | 关闭思考 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| JSON 抽取 | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| 格式约束 | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| 材料问答 | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| 正文首响中位数 | 1.113 秒 | 0.661 秒 |
| 请求总耗时中位数 | 1.153 秒 | 0.780 秒 |
| completion token 合计 | 1145 | 214 |
| API 报告的思考 token 合计 | 920 | 关闭；未返回此字段 |

completion token 包含思考消耗，不能全部算成用户看到的答案。两组使用相同题目，但上下文封装和 token 记账可能随模式不同；这不是严格隔离的性能实验。15 道题只覆盖少量短文本模式，也没有多次采样来估计稳定性。

sections.title: 代码题：两次金额解析失败值得看
sections.body:
| 任务 | 默认思考 | 关闭思考 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 金额字符串转整数分 | 截断，无代码 | 完成，但未通过 |
| 按 id 保序去重 | 通过 | 通过 |
| 闭区间合并与不可变输入 | 通过 | 通过 |

**关闭思考的金额题**：输入 `"0001.02"` 应返回 `102`，模型的正则只接受单个零或非零开头的整数，因此返回 `null`。题目没有禁止前导零。这是自行增加约束造成的实际错误。[查看原题、代码与检查](#evidence-code-money-disabled)

**默认思考的金额题**：`finish_reason=length`，4096 个 completion token 全部记为 reasoning，18.646 秒后结束，正文为空。18 项金额检查均未执行；这证明本次 4096 token 预算下未完成，不证明提高预算后仍不能解决。[查看完整记录](#evidence-code-money-default)

每个模式预设 26 项检查：金额 18、去重 3、区间 5。检查脚本遇到首个错误即停止，不能把后续未执行检查算成通过。两组各有 2 道完整通过的函数题；这里报告任务级 2/3，而不制造逐断言通过率。

sections.title: API 价格与这次测试花费
sections.body:
官方称此次升级价格不变。下面单位均为 **美元 / 百万 token**，查询日期为 2026-10-18。

| 计费类型 | 非高峰 | 高峰 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 缓存命中输入 | 0.003 | 0.006 |
| 缓存未命中输入 | 0.15 | 0.30 |
| 输出 | 0.60 | 1.20 |

这 36 次调用发生在周日，按官方非高峰价和 API 返回的缓存、输入、输出 usage 估算，共 **$0.004595**，包括截断失败请求。它是计算值，不是账户账单；未调用 Search/Fetch。[官方时段与计费规则](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/)

TOKRACE 体验额度与上游收费不同。页面的免费复测沿用本站现有额度；API 消费仍由对应凭据承担。

sections.title: 常见问题与复测建议
sections.body:
**API model 应该填什么？** 填 `deepseek-flash`，完整展示名 `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` 不是本次请求使用的 model 字段。

**能证明新版本比旧版更强吗？** 不能。官方成绩与本站小任务首测分开呈现；本次没有旧版配对基线，没有验证百万上下文、视觉、工具调用或完整仓库开发。

**怎样复测？** 下方按钮带入第一道抽取题、默认思考配置和官方接入点，在[竞速场](/zh-CN/arena)点击开始才会调用。本站共享入口使用服务端默认思考配置；要复现关闭思考组，请使用自己的官方 API Key，并提交 JSON 中记录的 `thinking.type=disabled`。完整题目、参数、usage、原始正文和代码检查均可下载。

查看[测试方法与限制](/zh-CN/method)、[全部实测报告](/zh-CN/reports)和[模型身份页](/zh-CN/model/deepseek-flash)。

en.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017: speed, pricing and coding tests
en.summary: 36 official API attempts: both text modes pass 15/15, with 1.113s and 0.661s median first-content latency. Includes two coding failures, parameters and raw answers.

sections.title: The result: short tasks pass; code still needs edge-case tests
sections.body:
TOKRACE made **36 direct requests** to the official DeepSeek API on October 18, 2026: 15 Chinese text tasks in each of two modes, plus 3 JavaScript tasks in each mode. No retries or failed attempts were discarded.

Both text groups passed **15/15**. Median time to first answer content was **1.113s** with default thinking and **0.661s** with thinking disabled. Both coding groups passed **2/3** tasks. The money parser exposed a budget-exhaustion failure and an incorrect leading-zero restriction.

Our practical reading: disabling thinking is worth trying for fixed-format extraction, while generated code still needs business-specific edge-case tests and explicit handling of incomplete outputs. These small tasks do not measure general reasoning, full-repository coding or agent quality.

sections.title: What is DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017?
sections.body:
The October 17 update uses the existing API alias `deepseek-flash`. That is also the model field returned in our responses. Checkpoint attribution relies on the [official change log](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates/); this mutable alias does not permanently pin a checkpoint.

Official specifications list 1M context, 384K maximum output, image input and tools. The weights have an MIT license. These are source claims; our tests cover short text and functions only. [Specifications](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/) · [Model card](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017)

The expired September preview ID `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` is a separate historical entry. Use the [current model page](/en/model/deepseek-flash).

sections.title: What changed in the vendor benchmarks?
sections.body:
These are vendor-reported results, not TOKRACE replications.

| Benchmark | September | 1017 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Terminal-Bench 4.0 | 31.2 | 42.3 |
| DeepSWE v1.1 | 74.2 | 77.0 |
| ProgramBench | 20.3 | 29.1 |

DeepSeek also reports shorter task runtimes and outputs. Terminal-Bench used Claude Code; DeepSWE used Mini-SWE-V2. We have no pinned September endpoint and cannot measure improvement over that checkpoint. [Official table and methodology notes](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017)

sections.title: Method: fixed tasks, request parameters and measurement path
sections.body:
The versioned suite `tasks-2026-09-26.1` contains 5 extraction, 5 instruction-format and 5 grounded-QA tasks, all in Chinese. Each gets one attempt per mode, with alternating mode order. Prompts, expected answers and checks were fixed before requests. Code tasks cover money parsing, stable deduplication and interval merging.

A local macOS client called `https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions` sequentially with streaming and a 120-second timeout. Egress and provider region are unverified. These results remain separate from Hong Kong standard reports and community speed telemetry.

Requests submitted `temperature=0`; text output budgets were 2048 tokens and coding budgets 4096. The default group omitted thinking settings; the other sent `thinking: {type: "disabled"}`. Official defaults enable thinking at high effort and ignore temperature in thinking mode. This is not deterministic sampling. [Thinking documentation](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode/)

First-content timing starts before the request and stops at the first nonempty answer delta, excluding reasoning. Total time ends at stream completion. We do not infer answer throughput from completion tokens. Cache state, network buffering and upstream load were uncontrolled.

sections.title: Measured results: pass rate, latency and tokens
sections.body:
| Text metric (15 attempts per mode) | Default thinking | Thinking disabled |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| JSON extraction | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| Instruction format | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| Grounded QA | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| Median first answer content | 1.113s | 0.661s |
| Median total request time | 1.153s | 0.780s |
| Total completion tokens | 1145 | 214 |
| Reported reasoning tokens | 920 | Disabled; field absent |

Completion tokens include reasoning, not just visible answers. Token accounting and context wrapping can differ between modes. This is a small observational test, not an isolated performance experiment. The suite has limited task diversity and no repeated sampling to estimate stability.

sections.title: Coding failures: a leading zero and an exhausted budget
sections.body:
| Task | Default thinking | Thinking disabled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Parse money into integer cents | Truncated; no code | Completed; failed checks |
| Stable deduplication by id | Passed | Passed |
| Merge closed intervals without mutation | Passed | Passed |

**Thinking disabled:** `"0001.02"` should produce `102`. The generated regex only permits a single zero or a nonzero starting digit, returning `null` instead. Leading zeros were never prohibited by the prompt. [Prompt, code and checks](#evidence-code-money-disabled)

**Default thinking:** the money task ended with `finish_reason=length` after 18.646 seconds. All 4096 completion tokens were reported as reasoning, with an empty answer. Its 18 planned checks were not run. This establishes failure under this budget, not inability with a larger budget. [Original attempt](#evidence-code-money-default)

Each mode has 26 predetermined checks: 18 for money, 3 for deduplication and 5 for intervals. The checker stops at its first failure. Unexecuted checks are not counted as passed. We report task-level 2/3 per mode rather than an invented assertion-level pass rate.

All 36 calls ran on Sunday. Applying off-peak prices to the returned input/cache/output usage gives **$0.004595**, including the truncated failure. This is an estimate, not an invoice. No Search/Fetch calls were made. [Official pricing rules](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/)

TOKRACE trial quotas are separate from upstream billing. The free rerun uses the site's existing allowance; upstream use is charged to the corresponding credential.

sections.title: FAQ and reproduction
sections.body:
**Which API model ID should I use?** `deepseek-flash`. The full display version `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` was not the request model ID in this test.

**Does this prove improvement over September?** No. Vendor benchmarks and our original tests are labeled separately. We did not test long context, vision, tools or repository-scale development and have no matched old-version baseline.

**How can I rerun it?** The button below loads the first extraction task, default thinking configuration and official endpoint in the [arena](/en/arena). It sends a model request only after you press Start. The shared trial uses server-controlled default thinking. Reproducing the disabled group requires your own official API key and the recorded `thinking.type=disabled` parameter. Download the prompts, request bodies, usage, original answers and code checks below.

See the [method and limitations](/en/method), [all reports](/en/reports) and [model identity](/en/model/deepseek-flash).
